main_text.head: SECT. VII.
main_text.p: Cafus 45Cafus Quartus refpicit poft-factum. Nam ut antequam juretur, & in ipfo jurandi actu, oportet effe propofitum adimplendi promiffum eo fenfu quo propofitum eft, fine aliqua æquivocatione aut mentali refervatione : ita poftquam juratum eft adfit oportet ftudium & conatus, ut idoneo tempore fideliter idipfum & eodem fenfu quo juratum eft adimpleatur fine aliqua evafione aut effugio. Atque ut unum perjurii genus eft, interjurandum detorquere verba in alium fenfum, quàm concipiunt audientes : fic alterum perjurii genus eft, ubi rectè juraveris, non fincerè agere, fed novo aliquo excogitato commento juramenti vim (salvis tamen verbis) declinare & Tacit. 4. hiftor.eludere. {a}Verbis jurisjurandi per varias artes mutantibus, quibus flagitii conscientia inerat, inquit de quibusdam Tacitus. Stobæus ferm.27.Lepidum recitat ex Herodoto {b}Stobæus de Archetimo quodam, qui apud Cydiam amicum nummos aliquot aureos depofuerat. Poft aliquod tempus Archetimo depofitum repetenti, Cydias præ auri cupidine acceptum negat. Res

page.notes: The right edge of the text is cut off by the scan edge; the final letters of several lines (e.g. "juramenti", "declinare &", "Res") were read from the visible stubs and the sense of the line. Reference marks: "a" before "Verbis" and "b" before "Stobæus" in the text. The marginal mark for the Stobæus note is read as "b" (it looks like "h" in the scan, but the text carries "b"). The margin note beside "Cafus" is printed in italic.
